Done. Final report to Master:

## What changed (file:line level)

**`.claude/hooks/post-tool-use.py`**
- Lines 179-209 (new): `workflow_name_from_path()` + `resolve_workflow_name()` — derive the name from `workflows/<name>/state.yaml` in the tool payload; YAML `workflow:` field is now only a fallback. `EVAL_PHANTOMS_DIR = runs/_phantoms` defined alongside.
- `create_eval_record_from_state` (now ~line 436, new `rel_path` param): name resolved via path first; if still unresolvable, `log_error` and return — a record named "unknown" is never written (fix 2). The old tag-and-write "phantom-candidate" block (~line 566) is now a real guard: empty-steps records are written to `runs/_phantoms/` with the correctly resolved name instead of the main runs dir (fix 3, quarantine branch — see "deliberately not done" below for why quarantine over skip).
- `update_eval_record_state_yaml` (~line 603): same path-first resolution; on total failure it keeps the record's existing name rather than stamping "unknown".
- `process_eval_harness` (~lines 812, 834): log line uses resolved name; `rel_path` passed through to `create_eval_record_from_state`.

**`.claude/hooks/eval-turn-stop.py`** — `sweep_orphaned_records` (~line 340): second pass deletes cowork-hook stubs that are `in-progress` with zero steps AND zero subagents after 2h (reuses `STALE_RECORD_ABORT_AFTER_HOURS`), per the err-20260829T161711-3IPMKR delete-don't-archive precedent (fix 4).

**Metric hygiene (fix 5)**: `systems/eval-harness/generate-dashboard.py` `load_eval_records` (~line 44) and `systems/eval-harness/version-trend.py` `load_records` (~line 46) now skip `phantom-candidate`-tagged records; `.claude/skills/rigby-eval-grade/SKILL.md` Step 1 gained exclusion rules (phantom-candidate tag, `_phantoms/` dir, name "unknown", and zero-activity in-progress stubs — the rule that would have prevented the sweep grading its own subagent stub an F).

**`systems/eval-harness/assertions/rigby-eval-grade.json`** (fix 6): the two assertions expecting `memory/working/rigby-eval-grade-*.md` (a file the skill never produces) replaced with `eval-grade-002-grading-stamped` (ISO `last_graded` on a record) and `eval-grade-003-notes-substantive` (grader_notes >20 chars) — matching the actual in-place-update deliverable.

**`evolutions/.pending-changes.json`**: tracked as `work-20260918-eval-phantom-guards`.

## Verification evidence

- `py_compile` clean on all four edited Python files; existing suite `test_detect_workflow.py` 26/26 pass.
- **Boot replay** (the exact phantom-producing write, real session id): hook logged `Skipped phantom workflow eval creation for 'boot' ... completed record already exists at eval-20260918T165813-0NC0AY.json` — name resolved from path, GUARD 1 fired, zero new files, 0NC0AY checksum `a10dce...` identical before/after.
- **Legitimate cowork path**: synthetic workflow with no `workflow:` field → record written to `_phantoms/` named `test-phantom-fix` (not "unknown"), tagged cowork-hook+phantom-candidate, main runs dir untouched.
- **Unresolvable name** (state.yaml outside workflows/, no YAML field): refused, logged, nothing written anywhere.
- **Orphan sweep**: seeded 23h-old in-progress cowork-hook stub deleted; seeded 30-min-old stub survived (both cleaned up after).
- **Metrics**: dashboard loader over today's records leaks zero phantom-candidates; `rigby-eval-grade` Tier 2 now scores **100% (3/3 structure)** on the same record that scored 72% this morning.

## Records deleted (all siblings re-verified immediately prior)

- `eval-20260918T171804-PH2FIV` ("unknown") → sibling `0NC0AY` (boot, success)
- `eval-20260918T080705-4A3L9C` (dream-cycle) → sibling `SWUKP0` (success, 4 steps)
- `eval-20260918T230346-IXSB15` (daily-review) → sibling `Z4WC4H` (success, 5 steps)
- `eval-20260918T230528-J4EJWW` (orphan agent stub) → sibling `9TVC2B` (rigby-eval-grade skill, success, same session). Note: J4EJWW had in fact finalized to `success` by deletion time (eval-agent-stop caught it after grading) — the "stuck in-progress forever" premise was overtaken by events, but the F grade it attracted was exactly the distortion being removed.

Committed: `adc09ccc fix(rigby): stop phantom eval records at creation, sweep, and metrics` (main, not pushed — left for the session-end protocol).

## Deliberately not done

- **Chose quarantine over hard-skip for fix 3.** Master's two instructions conflict (skip empty-steps writes vs. never regress the uninstrumented cowork path); the quarantine fallback Master specified resolves it — the record exists with its correct name for diagnosis but no metrics reader sees it.
- **Did not widen GUARD 1's session_id scoping.** The daily-review phantom slipped past GUARD 1 because `close-eval-record.py` read a stale session id from the index (`session-2026-09-18-115915`) while the hook payload carried `4d5db2b3...`. Name-only dedupe would suppress legitimate same-day reruns; the quarantine now catches this residue instead. The stale-index-id issue itself is a separate root cause worth its own entry.
- **Did not repair `eval-20260907T080916-ZF09EX.json`** — it contains a committed, unresolved git merge conflict (`<<<<<<< HEAD` at line 9) from the 2026-09-07 rebase incident. All readers skip it silently; repair-or-delete is your call.
- **Did not touch** the grader's stale-record date warning (it fired spuriously tonight because UTC rolled to 09-19 mid-session) — already flagged in the sweep's own findings as a separate issue.
